papers.title: Active learning for molecular property optimization
papers.abstract: A cheminformatics workflow combines uncertainty quantification, graph neural networks, and active learning for molecular property prediction in drug discovery.

papers.title: Docking benchmark for ligand design
papers.abstract: This virtual screening study evaluates protein-ligand docking and molecular dynamics refinement for lead optimization.

papers.title: Medical image segmentation with conformal prediction
papers.abstract: A general machine learning method improves uncertainty estimates for clinical image segmentation.

summaries.title: Active learning for molecular property optimization
summaries.tldr: The study evaluates active learning for molecular property prediction in drug discovery. It combines graph neural networks with uncertainty estimates to prioritize compounds.

summaries.title: Docking benchmark for ligand design
summaries.tldr: The paper studies docking and molecular dynamics refinement for virtual screening. The benchmark evidence focuses on lead optimization workflows.
